prs.title: Ask Jev per tool call and tool result against the whole stripped history
prs.author: tamara tran
prs.body:
State sent to Jev is now the entire conversation with tool outputs replaced
by a one-line note, fitted into a 25k-token budget in stages (tool inputs
truncated, long texts abridged oldest-first, old messages collapsed). For
every unpinned tool call two noul questions are asked (keep the call, keep
its full output); questions are batched across requests that each resend the
full state and stay under 30k estimated tokens. User/assistant text is never
dropped. Removes the unit grouping, kind classifier and drop/protect model.

+## Animated demo (macOS)
+
+`demo/JevDemo` is a small native SwiftUI app that plays a scripted, dramatized
+version of the compaction flow inside a Claude Code-style terminal: transcript
+chunks are scanned, marked green (keep) or red (drop), and the red ones
+collapse away. It uses a canned transcript and never calls the API; it exists
+to be screen recorded.
+
+```sh
+demo/JevDemo/build.sh   # builds demo/JevDemo/build/JevDemo.app and launches it
+```
+
+Press space in the app to replay from the start.
